notes: Adversaries as printed in the SRD. Numbers here match the book exactly - per-encounter tuning belongs in encounters/, so these stay checkable against the printed page. Entries are in the book's own tier-then-print order, and PORTED.md tracks which of the SRD's 129 are in and which are still out.

adversaries.name: Acid Burrower
adversaries.notes: Claws: Very Close, 1d12+2 physical. Experience: Tremor Sense +2.

adversaries.name: Bear
adversaries.notes: Claws: Melee, 1d8+3 physical. Experience: Ambusher +3, Keen Senses +2.

adversaries.name: Cave Ogre
adversaries.notes: Club: Very Close, 1d10+2 physical. Experience: Throw +2.

adversaries.name: Construct
adversaries.notes: Fist Slam: Melee, 1d20 physical - the one tier 1 standard attack with no flat bonus. No Experience printed.

adversaries.name: Dire Wolf
adversaries.notes: Claws: Melee, 1d6+2 physical. Experience: Keen Senses +3.

adversaries.name: Giant Mosquitoes
adversaries.notes: Proboscis: Melee, 1d8+3 physical. Experience: Camouflage +2. The type reads 'Horde (5/HP)' on the page - that is the Battle Points shorthand, not the feature's number, which is the 1d4+1 in the feature name.

adversaries.name: Giant Rat
adversaries.notes: Claws: Melee, a flat 1 physical - no dice at all, which is why damage_dice is empty and the whole attack sits in damage_modifier. Thresholds print as 'None'; a Minion is defeated by any damage, so there is no second HP for a threshold to matter for. Experience: Keen Senses +3.

adversaries.name: Giant Scorpion
adversaries.notes: Pincers: Melee, 1d12+2 physical. Experience: Camouflage +2. Momentum is the same feature the Bear carries and is already modelled.

adversaries.name: Glass Snake
adversaries.notes: Glass Fangs: Very Close, 1d8+2 physical. No Experience printed.

adversaries.name: Harrier
adversaries.notes: Javelin: Close, 1d6+2 physical. Experience: Camouflage +2. Fall Back is the first Reaction that interrupts an incoming attack rather than responding to one that landed.

adversaries.name: Archer Guard
adversaries.notes: Longbow: Far, 1d8+3 physical. Experience: Local Knowledge +3. Three HP against two Stress means the Stress-desperation rule never holds Hobbling Shot back - the Archer is always inside the line.

adversaries.name: Bladed Guard
adversaries.notes: Longsword: Melee, 1d6+1 physical. Experience: Local Knowledge +3.

adversaries.name: Head Guard
adversaries.notes: Mace: Melee, 1d10+4 physical. Experience: Commander +2, Local Knowledge +2. The first Leader ported - type carries no mechanics, so nothing in the loop reads it. The book prints the second feature as 'On My Signal - Reaction: Countdown (5)'; the 5 is the countdown's starting value and is carried as the feature's parameter, the way Flying (X) and Horde (X) carry theirs. Momentum is already modelled for the Bear.

adversaries.name: Jagged Knife Hexer
adversaries.notes: Staff: Far, 1d6+2 magic. Experience: Magical Knowledge +2. Damage types aren't tracked anywhere, so the magic damage resolves like any other - the same gap Weak Structure already declares.
